mapper.select: SELECT id, employeeId, name, email, department, position, phone, role, isActive FROM user ORDER BY department, name
SELECT id, employeeId, name, email, department, position, phone, role FROM user WHERE isActive = 1 ORDER BY department, name
SELECT id, employeeId, name, email, department, position, phone, role, isActive FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name=#{name}, email=#{email}, phone=#{phone}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET role=#{role}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET isActive=#{isActive}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (id, employeeId, email, passwordHash, name, department, position, phone, role, isActive, updatedAt) VALUES (UUID(), #{employeeId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{department}, #{position}, #{phone}, #{role}, 1, NOW())
